entities.summary: Juhan Parts is an Estonian politician who was Prime Minister of Estonia from 2003 to 2005 and Minister of Economic Affairs and Communications from 2007 to 2014. Juhan Parts is a member of Isamaa party. Juhan Parts was a legal figures from Tallinn (b. 1966-08-27, Tallinn). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
